title: The Rabbit and the Turtle
moral: Even if you go slowly, you can make it if you keep going!
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다. 2026-10-23 사용자 지시: 중간중간 응원하는 동물을 모두 뺐다. 나무 그늘의 돼지 자리, 돌멩이 길의 강아지·고양이, 개울의 오리, 언덕의 양 응원(자리·글자·소리 vo:cheer_*)과 줄 "응원하던 친구들도 쉿!"·"꿈속 친구들이 모두 토끼에게 짝짝짝 박수를 쳤어요."(대본에서만 제외, 녹음 클립은 그대로)를 뺐다. 출발 전 초대장·응원석 소개, 출발선 구경, 결승과 시상식·잔치의 동물은 남겼다.

lines.en: Morning has come to the forest village.
segs: Morning has come to the forest village.

lines.text: 해님이 방긋 떠오르고, 새들이 짹짹 노래했어요.
lines.en: The sun peeked up with a smile, and the birds sang tweet, tweet.
segs: The sun peeked up with a smile, and the birds sang tweet, tweet.

lines.en: The turtle takes a slow, slow walk.
segs: The turtle takes a slow, slow walk.

lines.en: "Hi! I'm Turtle."
Hop, hop! Here comes the rabbit too.
segs: Hop, hop! Here comes the rabbit too.

lines.en: "Hi! I'm Rabbit, the hoppy one!"
segs: Hi! I'm Rabbit, the hoppy one!

lines.text: 숲속 길에서 토끼와 거북이가 마주 섰어요.
lines.en: Rabbit and Tortoise stood face to face on the forest path.
segs: Rabbit and Tortoise stood face to face on the forest path.

lines.text: 토끼는 거북이의 짧은 다리를 보고 킥킥 웃었어요.
lines.en: The rabbit looked at the turtle's short little legs and giggled.
segs: The rabbit looked at the turtle's short little legs and giggled.

lines.en: The rabbit said, "Hey, slowpoke! Want to race me?"
segs: Hey, slowpoke! Want to race me?

lines.en: The turtle gave a big smile. "Okay!"
segs: The turtle gave a big smile.

lines.en: Slow is fine. I will go all the way to the end.
segs: Slow is fine. I will go all the way to the end.

lines.text: 거북이는 느릿느릿 걸어도 한 번 마음먹으면 끝까지 하는 친구였거든요.
lines.en: The turtle plodded along ever so slowly, but once he made up his mind, he never gave up.
segs: The turtle plodded along ever so slowly, but once he made up his mind, he never gave up.

lines.en: "Let's ask our forest friends to cheer for us!"
segs: Let's ask our forest friends to cheer for us!

lines.text: 경주 소식을 전하려고 부엉이가 마을 집집마다 날아갔어요.
lines.en: Owl flew from house to house to tell everyone about the race.
segs: Owl flew from house to house to tell everyone about the race.

lines.en: The owl mail carrier brought the invitations.
segs: The owl mail carrier brought the invitations.

lines.text: 똑똑! 문을 두드리자 오리, 소, 돼지, 강아지가 얼굴을 쏙 내밀었어요.
lines.en: Knock, knock! When the owl tapped on the doors, the duck, the cow, the pig and the puppy all peeked out.
segs: Knock, knock! When the owl tapped on the doors, the duck, the cow, the pig and the puppy all peeked out.

lines.en: The rooster, the sheep, and the cat got invitations too!
segs: The rooster, the sheep, and the cat got invitations too!

lines.text: 초대장을 받은 친구들은 경주 길 옆 응원석으로 갔어요.
lines.en: The invited friends went to the seats beside the race path.
segs: The invited friends went to the seats beside the race path.

lines.en: The animal friends gathered to cheer!
segs: The animal friends gathered to cheer!

lines.en: All the friends jump up and cheer!
segs: All the friends jump up and cheer!

lines.en: Wow, what a happy cheer!

lines.text: 모두 응원석에 옹기종기 앉아 두근두근 경주를 기다렸지요.
lines.en: Everyone snuggled up together in the cheering seats, hearts going pitter-patter, waiting for the race.
segs: Everyone snuggled up together in the cheering seats, hearts going pitter-patter, waiting for the race.

lines.text: 토끼와 거북이는 친구들 앞 출발선에 나란히 섰어요.
lines.en: Rabbit and Tortoise lined up at the start in front of their friends.
segs: Rabbit and Tortoise lined up at the start in front of their friends.

lines.en: Before the race, let's do warm-up exercises.
segs: Before the race, let's do warm-up exercises.

lines.en: The rabbit stretches its ears, up, up!
segs: The rabbit stretches its ears, up, up!

lines.en: The turtle stretches its neck, long, long!
segs: The turtle stretches its neck, long, long!

lines.en: Wow, the turtle's neck stretched waaay long!
segs: Wow, the turtle's neck stretched waaay long!

lines.en: The raccoon referee brought a big drum.
segs: The raccoon referee brought a big drum.

lines.text: 친구들은 모두 숨을 죽이고 두근두근 북을 바라보았어요.
lines.en: All the friends held their breath, hearts thumping, and stared at the drum.
segs: All the friends held their breath, hearts thumping, and stared at the drum.

lines.text: 둥둥! 북소리가 쿵쿵 울리자 둘은 나란히 출발했어요.
lines.en: Boom, boom! The drum thumped and thundered, and off they went, side by side.
segs: Boom, boom! The drum thumped and thundered, and off they went, side by side.

lines.text: 토끼는 쌩~ 거북이는 엉금 한 발!
lines.en: The rabbit zooms off~ The turtle takes one slow step!
segs: The rabbit zooms off~ The turtle takes one slow step!

lines.from: 토끼는 쌩쌩 달려요! 화면을 톡톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: The rabbit zooms along!

lines.text: 돌멩이도 개울도 폴짝폴짝, 눈 깜짝할 사이에 지나갔지요.
lines.en: Hop, hop! Over the rocks and across the stream, quick as a wink.
segs: Hop, hop! Over the rocks and across the stream, quick as a wink.

lines.text: 금세 언덕 위 나무 그늘까지 왔어요.
lines.en: Soon the rabbit reached the shady tree on the hill.
segs: Soon the rabbit reached the shady tree on the hill.

lines.en: Looking back... no turtle in sight!
segs: Looking back... no turtle in sight!

lines.en: That turtle must still be way, way back. Hee hee.
segs: That turtle must still be way, way back. Hee hee.

lines.en: "Yaaawn~ I can take a little nap~"
segs: Yaaawn~ I can take a little nap~

lines.text: 토끼는 나무 아래에 벌렁 드러누워 하암~ 하품을 했어요.
lines.en: The rabbit flopped down under the tree and let out a big yaaawn.
segs: The rabbit flopped down under the tree and let out a big yaaawn.

lines.en: Snuggle, snuggle~ The blanket is tucked in.
segs: Snuggle, snuggle~ The blanket is tucked in.

lines.from: 부엉이가 자장가를 불러 줘요. 잘 들어 봐요.
lines.en: The owl sings a lullaby.

lines.text: 부엉 부엉~ 토끼 눈이 스르르 감겨요.
lines.en: Hoo hoo~ The rabbit's eyes slowly close.
segs: Hoo hoo~ The rabbit's eyes slowly close.

lines.text: 구름도 뭉게뭉게 다가와 해님을 살며시 가려 주었어요.
lines.en: A fluffy, puffy cloud drifted over, soft and slow, and covered up the sun.
segs: A fluffy, puffy cloud drifted over, soft and slow, and covered up the sun.

lines.en: The rabbit fell fast asleep. Zzz.
segs: The rabbit fell fast asleep. Zzz.

lines.en: The rabbit is dreaming. In the dream, the rabbit came in first!
segs: The rabbit is dreaming. In the dream, the rabbit came in first!

lines.from: 상으로 커다란 당근을 받았어요. 당근을 톡!
lines.en: As a prize, the rabbit got a giant carrot.
segs: As a prize, the rabbit got a giant carrot.

lines.en: "Crunch! Mmm, yummy!"

lines.text: 하지만 진짜 토끼는 나무 아래에서 드르렁 쿨쿨~
lines.en: But the real rabbit is under the tree, snoring, zzz~
segs: But the real rabbit is under the tree, snoring, zzz~

lines.text: 토끼가 자는 동안, 거북이는 숲속 경주 길을 따라갔어요.
lines.en: While Rabbit slept, Tortoise followed the race path through the forest.
segs: While Rabbit slept, Tortoise followed the race path through the forest.

lines.en: Meanwhile, what about the turtle? Plod, plod, walking along.
segs: Meanwhile, what about the turtle? Plod, plod, walking along.

lines.text: 엉금엉금, 한 발 또 한 발. 거북이는 한 번도 쉬지 않았어요.
lines.en: Plod, plod, one step, then another. The turtle never stopped, not even once.
segs: Plod, plod, one step, then another. The turtle never stopped, not even once.

lines.from: 어? 커다란 돌멩이예요! 돌멩이를 톡 해서 넘어가요!
lines.en: Oh! A big rock!
Heave-ho! The turtle made it over the rock!
segs: The turtle made it over the rock!

lines.text: 앗, 개울이에요! 거북이는 헤엄을 잘 쳐요.
lines.en: Oh, a stream! The turtle is a good swimmer.
segs: Oh, a stream! The turtle is a good swimmer.

lines.en: Splish, splash! The turtle paddled right through the rippling water.
segs: Splish, splash! The turtle paddled right through the rippling water.

lines.en: The turtle crossed the stream with the fish!
segs: The turtle crossed the stream with the fish!

lines.en: Now there's a tall hill.

lines.text: 영차, 영차. 거북이는 느릿느릿, 그래도 멈추지 않고 올라갔어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho. Slowly, slowly, but without stopping, the turtle climbed on up.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho. Slowly, slowly, but without stopping, the turtle climbed on up.

lines.en: Heave-ho! The turtle reached the top of the hill.
segs: The turtle reached the top of the hill.

lines.text: 언덕을 오른 거북이가 토끼가 자는 나무 곁에 왔어요.
lines.en: At the top of the hill, Tortoise reached the tree where Rabbit slept.
segs: At the top of the hill, Tortoise reached the tree where Rabbit slept.

lines.text: 위에는 쿨쿨 자는 토끼, 아래에는 거북이!
lines.en: Up above, the rabbit sleeps. Down below, the turtle!
segs: Up above, the rabbit sleeps. Down below, the turtle!

lines.en: Shh, tiptoe past quietly~ sneak, sneak.
segs: Shh, tiptoe past quietly~ sneak, sneak.

lines.en: Wow, the turtle passed the rabbit!
segs: Wow, the turtle passed the rabbit!

lines.en: The sun is slowly setting.

lines.text: 그때 닭이 큰 소리로 울었어요. 꼬끼오!
lines.en: Just then the rooster crowed as loud as he could. Cock-a-doodle-doo!
segs: Just then the rooster crowed as loud as he could. Cock-a-doodle-doo!

lines.en: The rabbit jumped right up! "Oh no, I fell asleep!"

lines.text: 거북이가 결승선 가까이 오자 친구들이 몸을 쭉 내밀었어요.
lines.en: As Tortoise neared the finish line, the friends leaned forward to watch.
segs: As Tortoise neared the finish line, the friends leaned forward to watch.

lines.en: All the cheering friends stood up!
segs: All the cheering friends stood up!

lines.text: 토끼가 쌩쌩 달려와요! 거북이는 딱 한 발 남았어요.
lines.en: The rabbit is zooming back! The turtle has just one step left.
segs: The rabbit is zooming back! The turtle has just one step left.

lines.text: "영차, 조금만 더. 조금만 더 가면 돼."
lines.en: Heave-ho, just a little more. Just a little more and I am there.
segs: Heave-ho, just a little more. Just a little more and I am there.

lines.text: 거북이는 후우 숨을 크게 쉬고 마지막 한 발을 쿵 내디뎠어요.
lines.en: The turtle took a big, deep breath, whoosh, and stomped out one last step. Thump!
segs: The turtle took a big, deep breath, whoosh, and stomped out one last step. Thump!

lines.text: 찰칵! 둘이 결승선에 닿는 순간이 사진에 담겼어요.
lines.en: Click! A photo caught the moment they reached the finish line.
segs: Click! A photo caught the moment they reached the finish line.

lines.text: 사진을 보니… 거북이 코끝이 먼저 닿았어요!
lines.en: Look at the photo... the turtle's nose touched first!
segs: Look at the photo... the turtle's nose touched first!

lines.en: The turtle is number one!

lines.text: 경주가 끝나고, 거북이는 시상대 위로 올라갔어요.
lines.en: After the race, Tortoise climbed onto the prize stand.
segs: After the race, Tortoise climbed onto the prize stand.

lines.en: It's the award ceremony! The cheering friends do the wave.
segs: It's the award ceremony! The cheering friends do the wave.

lines.en: Sparkle, sparkle, a gold medal!

lines.text: 거북이는 반짝반짝 메달을 목에 걸고 활짝 웃었어요.
lines.en: The turtle wore the sparkly, twinkly medal around his neck and smiled a great big smile.
segs: The turtle wore the sparkly, twinkly medal around his neck and smiled a great big smile.

lines.en: The rabbit came over and said,
segs: The rabbit came over and said,

lines.text: "축하해! 다음엔 나도 쉬지 않고 열심히 할게."
lines.en: "Congratulations! Next time I'll work hard and never stop to rest."
segs: Congratulations! Next time I'll work hard and never stop to rest.

lines.text: 거북이도 말했어요. "고마워! 우리 또 같이 달리자!"
lines.en: The turtle said, "Thank you! Let's race together again!"
segs: Thank you! Let's race together again!

lines.en: Night came. The forest party began!
segs: Night came. The forest party began!

lines.text: 친구들은 둥둥 북을 치고 딸랑딸랑 방울을 흔들었어요.
lines.en: The friends beat the drums, boom, boom, and shook the bells, jingle, jingle.
segs: The friends beat the drums, boom, boom, and shook the bells, jingle, jingle.

lines.en: Everyone had a happy party together.
segs: Everyone had a happy party together.

lines.text: 천천히 가도 끝까지 하면 해낼 수 있어요!
lines.en: Even if you go slowly, you can make it if you keep going!
segs: Even if you go slowly, you can make it if you keep going!
